result.coverage_note: Reviewed supplied text from all 15 PDF pages. Supplementary tables and figure pixels were unavailable; the finding is supported directly by the main text.

findings.candidate_quote: showing lower rates of microscopic hematuria than both other groups
findings.reference_quote:
There was no difference in
24h-uPro, but the IgAN + DKD group exhibited a higher incidence of MH (57.50% vs. 31.25%, p = 0.001),
uRBC count, and proportion of dysmorphic uRBC.
findings.explanation: The summary reverses the comparison with DKD. Microscopic hematuria was less frequent than in primary IgAN but significantly more frequent than in DKD (57.50% versus 31.25%), rather than less frequent than in both groups.
